meta.title: Full Page Screenshot & Editor for Chrome — OpenScreenShot
meta.description: Free, open-source Chrome extension for full page, visible area and region screenshots, with an annotation editor, export to PNG, JPEG, WebP or PDF, and a tab recorder. Nothing leaves your machine.

hero.title2: So private it works with Wi-Fi off.
hero.sub: Full page, markup, export, tab recording — right in Chrome. No account, no watermark, no cloud.
hero.credit: The site in these screenshots is OpenTechCheck, also by us — see what any website is built with.

capture.label: Capture
capture.alt: The OpenScreenShot popup open over a web page in Chrome, with Full Page, Visible Area, Selected Region and Record options.

annotate.label: Annotate
annotate.alt: The OpenScreenShot editor with its tool rail, color palette and stroke controls, showing a full page capture of opentechcheck.com with a box and an arrow drawn on it.

export.label: Export
export.alt: The export dialog in the OpenScreenShot editor, with PNG selected, JPEG, WebP and PDF beside it, a scale row, a width field and a filename field.

record.label: Record
record.alt: The OpenScreenShot recorder with a recorded page in the preview, cursor and tab volume controls, and a timeline with two 2x zoom blocks.

quartet.title: Capture anything
quartet.body: The whole page, the visible area, or a region you drag. One click, a shortcut, or the right-click menu.

quartet.title: Edit before you share
quartet.body: Arrows, boxes and text to make your point. Blur for the parts nobody else should see.

quartet.title: Record the tab
quartet.body: One click records, with auto zoom at every click. Trim on a timeline, then export WebM.

quartet.title: Private by default
quartet.body: No account, no upload, no telemetry. It works with your Wi-Fi off.

privacy.heading: Nobody can see what you capture. Not even us.
privacy.lede: Screenshots are often the most sensitive images on your machine. Capture, editing, export, PDF and recording all run in your browser. The extension makes no network request of its own, and it has no standing access to any site you visit.
privacy.installFold: What it asks for at install
privacy.recordFold: What recording adds, only when you record
privacy.micFine: The microphone and camera, when you enable them, are opened by your browser’s own permission prompt. The stream never leaves your device.
privacy.moreFine: The same tables, with the full policy, on the Privacy page.

cta.heading: Ready in ten seconds.

steps.title: Add it to Chrome
steps.body: One click on the Chrome Web Store. Free, and no sign-up.

steps.title: Click the icon
steps.body: Or press the shortcut. Pick full page, visible area, or a region.

steps.title: Capture
steps.body: Annotate, export, or copy. It never leaves your machine.

cta.browsersFine: Works on Chrome, Edge, Brave, Arc and other Chromium browsers.
